identity: A page-owned text editor with a code view or document view, editing controls, and indicators for the current position or document state.

scenarios.name: cursor
scenarios.screen: The code view shows numbered lines, a text gutter, syntax-coloured text, a minimap, and a status bar with the current line and column; no text is selected. The document view shows paragraphs beneath a toolbar with an editing-mode control.
never: A browser contenteditable field
Two separate code files open side by side
A suggestion card in the code view

arrangements.text: The code text sits between the line-number gutter on the left and the minimap on the right, with the status bar below.
The document toolbar sits above the paragraphs, with the editing-mode control in the toolbar.

scenarios.name: multiline
scenarios.screen: A single code editor shows numbered lines, a gutter, syntax-coloured text, a minimap, and a line-and-column status bar. The target lines are still in their original form, and no find widget or completion list is open.
never: A document formatting toolbar
Suggestion cards
A second editor pane
Lines already removed from the editor

arrangements.text: Line numbers run down the left of the code, the minimap runs down the right, and the status bar sits below the editor.
The code editor fills a narrower task area while the gutter remains beside the text, the minimap remains at its right edge, and the status bar remains underneath.

scenarios.name: multicursor
scenarios.screen: A single code editor shows numbered lines, a gutter, syntax-coloured text, a minimap, and a line-and-column status bar. The requested edits have not been made, and no find widget is open.
never: A separate input box for each cursor
A document formatting toolbar
Suggestion cards
A second code pane

arrangements.text: The gutter is left of the code text, the minimap is right of it, and the status bar is below.
The editor occupies a narrower task area, keeping the gutter beside the code and the minimap along the editor's right edge.

scenarios.name: findreplace
scenarios.screen: The code view shows its numbered editor, minimap, and status bar, while the document view shows paragraphs and a toolbar. In either view, the find-and-replace widget is closed and its query and replacement fields are not visible.
never: A find-and-replace panel already open with filled fields
Search results in a separate file list
A replacement preview across multiple documents

arrangements.text: The code sits between its left gutter and right minimap, with the status bar below and the closed find control at the editor.
The document toolbar sits above the paragraphs, with the closed find control among the document controls.

scenarios.name: autocomplete
scenarios.screen: A single code editor shows numbered lines, syntax-coloured text, a minimap, and a line-and-column status bar. The requested new lines are absent, and the completion list is closed until typing opens it.
never: A completion list containing results from another file
The requested new lines already present
A document formatting toolbar
Suggestion cards

arrangements.text: The line-number gutter sits left of the code, the minimap sits right of it, and the status bar spans the bottom.
A narrower editor keeps the gutter beside the text and the minimap at the far right, with the status bar directly below.

scenarios.name: trackchanges
scenarios.screen: A document editor shows paragraphs beneath a toolbar with Editing, Suggesting, and Viewing modes. In a review task, open suggestions have attributed cards with Accept and Reject controls.
never: A code gutter with line numbers
A code minimap
A suggestion already accepted or rejected in the normal unsolved review start
A separate document for each suggestion

arrangements.text: The toolbar sits above the document paragraphs, and suggestion cards sit beside their corresponding text.
The toolbar sits above a narrower document column, with suggestion cards in a column to its right.
